description.subtitle: FC Barcelona Aitana's Nike third kit women's t-shirt for the Women's Champions 2026 2027 - turquoise
description.tagline: Blaugrana history on a women's t-shirt
description.intro: The Nike 3a Barcelona Women's 26 27 Dri-Fit Stadium Jersey carries the inspiration of Barça's 1996 away kit to the 2026/27 season, celebrating 30 years of Nike revolutionizing the world of football. This Stadium version for women combines details inspired by the match kit with a construction aimed at the comfort of fans.
key_benefits: Comfort for the fan: Its construction is designed to enjoy football in comfort.
Moisture Management: Fabric helps draw sweat away from the skin to keep you feeling drier.
Design with history: Recovers the inspiration of the FC Barcelona second kit from 1996.
Stadium Aesthetics: Combines replica-like details with a construction prepared for everyday use.
Blaugrana pride: The woven shield reinforces the official identity of FC Barcelona.
